behavioral_reflex: Map of trigger -> {bias_weight 0..1, prefer_action}. Unstated bias on action selection; never a line telling the character what joke to make.
conscious_self: What the character believes: occupation, goal, self_belief. This (and only this) goes into character calls.
director_private: blindspot (unrecognized trait), latent_drive (hidden want), defensive_pattern. Director calls only. Never in character context.
note: Access control, not prompt instruction. Template for the cast; instantiate per character.
perception_rules: success_attribution and failure_attribution: how the character misreads outcomes (luck->skill, failure->sabotage). Supplied as observed tendencies in memories, never as labels.
